evals.prompt: I'm building a task management app with TanStack Start and Jazz. Users should be able to create tasks with a title and description, and see them in a list. I have the basic TanStack Start setup but no Jazz schemas or components yet. Can you help me build this feature with TDD?
evals.expected_output: Should follow outside-in TDD: start with a failing test (Playwright E2E acceptance test or Vitest Browser Mode component integration test), then implement schema → hook → component one RED→GREEN cycle at a time. Should define Jazz CoValue schemas (Task, TaskList). Should NOT mock jazz-tools. Should use vertical slices. Should use setupJazzTestSync() and createJazzTestAccount() for test setup.

assertions.text: Starts with a failing test (Playwright E2E acceptance test or Vitest Browser Mode component integration test) before any implementation code
Uses vertical slices (one RED→GREEN cycle at a time) rather than writing all tests first
Uses setupJazzTestSync() for Jazz testing — does NOT vi.mock('jazz-tools')
Uses createJazzTestAccount() to create test identities
Defines Jazz CoValue schemas using co.map() for Task and co.list() for TaskList
Verifies behavior through rendered UI (expect.element visible) not CoValue internals
Includes a planning phase identifying Jazz CoValues needed and behaviors to test
Test names describe behaviors (e.g., 'user can create a task') not methods

evals.prompt: I need to add a sharing feature to my Jazz + TanStack Start task app. Users should be able to share a project with other users via an invite link, giving them writer access. When sharing, we also need to notify the invited user via our external email API at POST /api/emails/send. I have the Project and Task schemas already. How do I test-drive this?
evals.expected_output: Should identify two boundaries: Jazz Groups for sharing permissions (real in-memory sync) and MSW for the external email API. Should create Jazz Groups with correct roles. Should use createInviteLink() for invite flow. Should test multi-user scenario with createJazzTestAccount + setActiveAccount. Should reload CoValues after setActiveAccount(). Should NOT mock jazz-tools.

assertions.text: Identifies and explains the two-boundary model: Jazz sync for permissions, MSW for external email API
Uses Jazz Groups with addMember() and correct roles (writer) for sharing — not a custom permissions layer
Uses MSW to mock the external email API (POST /api/emails/send)
Tests multi-user scenario with createJazzTestAccount for both sharer and invitee
Reloads CoValues after setActiveAccount() to get new permission context
Does NOT use vi.mock('jazz-tools') or mock Jazz internals
Uses vertical slices (one RED→GREEN cycle at a time)
Uses createInviteLink() or Group.addMember() for the invite/sharing mechanism

evals.prompt: I want to build a real-time collaborative dashboard with TanStack Start + Jazz. It should show a list of metrics (name + value) that multiple team members can update simultaneously. When a metric is updated by one user, all connected users should see the change. I need a walking skeleton first, then we'll build out the full feature. How should I approach this with TDD?
evals.expected_output: Should start with a walking skeleton: a Playwright E2E test proving the thinnest end-to-end slice works (build/deploy/test infrastructure). Then use Vitest Browser Mode component integration tests with JazzTestProvider + setupJazzTestSync() to drive implementation. Should define CoValue schemas for Metric and MetricList. Should test real-time updates by mutating CoValues and asserting UI updates. Should use useCoState for reactive rendering. Should follow GOOS walking skeleton → incremental loop pattern.

assertions.text: Starts with a walking skeleton — the thinnest possible end-to-end slice, ideally a Playwright E2E test proving infrastructure works
Uses setupJazzTestSync() and JazzTestProvider for authentic sync testing
Tests real-time sync by mutating a CoValue and asserting the UI updates reactively
Defines appropriate CoValue schemas (e.g., Metric as co.map, MetricList as co.list)
Uses useCoState hook for reactive data rendering in components
After walking skeleton, follows incremental RED→GREEN loop for additional behaviors
Considers or tests multi-user scenario (multiple team members editing simultaneously)
Uses Vitest Browser Mode (vitest-browser-react) for component tests, not jsdom/RTL
